tldr: SpaceX 完成史上最大規模 IPO，掛牌首日大漲約 19%、市值衝上 2.1 兆美元，馬斯克成為全球首位兆元富豪。
美伊有望簽署和平協議、重啟荷姆茲海峽，布蘭特原油重挫逾 3% 至三個月新低，全球風險偏好同步回升。
台股大漲 1,019 點收 44,169 點，外資回補 286.9 億元、轉進金融與航運，終止連六賣。
13 家金控前五月稅後純益達 3,673 億元、年增 136% 創新高，超級股東會同聲看好 AI 驅動的成長前景。
美國 5 月 CPI 升至三年新高 4.2%、歐洲央行 2023 年來首度升息，凸顯伊朗能源衝擊正重塑全球利率走向。

items.title_zh: 台股大漲 1,019 點收 44,169 點 外資回補終止連六賣
items.title_en: TAIEX surges 1,019 points to 44,169 as foreign buyers return
items.summary_zh: 美國總統川普取消對伊朗空襲計畫、釋出和平協議訊號，激勵台股今日強彈 1,019.58 點、約 2.4%，收在 44,169.04 點，成交量 1.12 兆元。外資回補 286.9 億元，終止連六賣，轉進金融與航空族群，但本周仍倒貨約 2,862 億元。台積電等權值股領漲帶動指數收復失土；惟法人提醒，下周 FOMC 會議若放鷹，加上夜盤波動劇烈，反彈動能仍待量能確認，短線宜留意高檔震盪風險。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index jumped 1,019.58 points, or roughly 2.4%, to close at 44,169.04 on turnover of NT$1.12 trillion, after President Trump scrapped a planned strike on Iran and signalled a peace deal that calmed geopolitical nerves. Foreign institutions snapped a six-session selling streak with NT$28.69 billion of net buying, rotating into financials and airlines, even though they remained net sellers of NT$286.2 billion for the week. TSMC and other heavyweights led the bounce, but strategists cautioned that next week's Fed meeting and a hawkish risk keep the rally fragile.

items.title_zh: SpaceX 掛牌點火 台股低軌衛星、PCB 供應鏈沸騰
items.title_en: SpaceX listing ignites Taiwan's low-orbit satellite and PCB supply chain
items.summary_zh: SpaceX 史上最大 IPO 帶動台股太空概念股族群同步噴出，低軌衛星與 PCB 供應鏈獲法人積極卡位。法人指出，除華通外，多檔 PCB 與衛星零組件廠可望受惠 Starlink 布建與發射頻次加速的需求擴張，盤前更傳出法人逾 60 億元卡位特定 PCB 個股。不過分析師提醒，IPO 蜜月行情過後，下周起恐出現科技股資金排擠效應，追高該題材仍須謹守進場紀律與停利停損，避免在過熱族群追高套牢。
items.summary_en: The historic SpaceX IPO lit a fire under Taiwan's space-related supply chain, with low-earth-orbit satellite and PCB names drawing heavy institutional interest. Brokers flagged that beyond Unitech (華通), a cluster of PCB and satellite-component makers stand to benefit from accelerating Starlink and launch-cadence demand, and institutions reportedly parked some NT$6 billion around a favoured PCB stock pre-market. Analysts nonetheless warned that the post-honeymoon phase could trigger funding rotation out of crowded tech names from next week, so chasing the theme requires discipline on entry points.

items.title_zh: 台股爆 3 檔逾 7,034 萬違約交割 追高欣興遭割韭菜
items.title_en: Three stocks log NT$70 million of default settlements amid wild swings
items.summary_zh: 台股本周先跌後漲、劇烈震盪一度回測 4 萬 2 關卡，證交所與櫃買中心今日公告 3 檔個股違約交割共計 7,034.4 萬元。市場傳出散戶追高欣興等熱門股慘遭套牢，竹北雙分點同步翻車。本事件再次凸顯，在外資主導、波動劇烈的盤勢中以融資或當沖追高，違約交割風險急遽升高。即便大盤隨後強彈收復多數失土，投資人仍應嚴控部位與槓桿，避免因短線追價衝動而承擔無法交割的重大損失。
items.summary_en: Amid the week's violent see-saw, the TWSE and TPEx announced that three individual stocks racked up NT$70.34 million of combined default settlements, after the index whipsawed and briefly retested the 42,000 level before rebounding. Reports pointed to retail investors who chased Unimicron (欣興) and other hot names getting caught, with twin branch offices in Zhubei seeing synchronised blow-ups. The episode is a reminder that leveraged chasing into a volatile, foreign-fund-driven tape carries acute settlement risk, even as the broader market staged a sharp recovery.

items.title_zh: 台積電屏東動土 魏哲家：缺人才是最大挑戰
items.title_en: TSMC chairman says talent shortage is the biggest challenge at Pingtung groundbreaking
items.summary_zh: 台積電董事長魏哲家偕總統賴清德出席屏東科學園區半導體供應鏈專區聯合動土典禮，感謝政府提供土地、水、電支援，有助公司在台灣長期發展，但直言「缺人才」是台積電當前最大挑戰。此番談話正值台積電全球地位持續攀升之際，據集邦統計，首季全球前十大晶圓代工產值達 479.5 億美元再創高，台積電市占率升至 72%。魏哲家的提醒凸顯，限制台灣晶片雄心的關鍵已非產能或資金，而是高階人才的供給；如何擴大人才庫，成為產業與政府共同的長期課題。
items.summary_en: TSMC Chairman C.C. Wei attended the joint groundbreaking for the semiconductor supply-chain zone at Pingtung Science Park alongside President Lai Ching-te, thanking the government for land, water and power support that aids the firm's long-term roots in Taiwan, but stressing that "lack of talent" remains TSMC's single biggest obstacle. The comments land as TSMC's global dominance grows—first-quarter data showed it holding 72% of the worldwide foundry market—yet underscore that human capital, not capacity or capital, is now the binding constraint on Taiwan's chip ambitions.

items.title_zh: 貨櫃運價飆 SCFI 周漲 9.5% 貨櫃三雄喊衝
items.title_en: Container freight roars back: SCFI jumps 9.5% in a week
items.summary_zh: 最新一期上海出口集裝箱運價指數（SCFI）大漲 258.74 點至 2,985 點、周漲 9.5%，全球貨櫃海運再現強勁多頭，帶動長榮、陽明、萬海貨櫃三雄走強。航運業者點出搶運需求、艙位偏緊與運價紀律三大因素支撐價格，6 月 15 日的月中漲價已「漲定了」。同時交通部規劃未來 5 年投入 572 億元打造智慧、韌性商港，估 2031 年貨櫃量上看 1,550 萬 TEU。運價回升疊加長線基礎建設投資，顯示航運景氣動能可望延續，惟須留意美伊情勢若緩和、繞道需求回落的反向風險。
items.summary_en: The latest Shanghai Containerized Freight Index surged 258.74 points to 2,985, a weekly gain of 9.5%, reigniting a strong bull run in global container shipping and lifting Taiwan's "big three" carriers Evergreen, Yang Ming and Wan Hai. Shipping operators cite three drivers—front-loading demand, tight capacity and rate discipline—supporting prices, with a mid-month rate hike on June 15 seen as locked in. The rebound, alongside a NT$57.2 billion five-year government plan to expand commercial ports toward 15.5 million TEU by 2031, signals durable momentum in the sector.

items.title_zh: 重電、玻纖搭上 AI 資本支出浪潮 訂單旺到 2029
items.title_en: Heavy-electrical and glass-fibre makers ride the AI capex wave
items.summary_zh: AI 驅動的電力與材料需求，正把台廠訂單能見度拉長數年。華城總經理許逸德表示，目前仍看不見重電產業高原期，在手訂單滿載並已接到 2029 年。台玻董事長林伯豐則指出，受惠 AI 與高效能運算需求強勁，今年將再投入逾 20 億元擴充低介電（Low DK）與 Low CTE 玻纖布產線，並坦言玻纖布缺貨將延續至明年。加上外電報導機電四雄訂單同樣旺到 2029 年，顯示 AI 基礎建設硬體並非短線題材，而是進入多年期的結構性上升循環，惟仍須觀察終端資料中心資本支出的續航力。
items.summary_en: AI-driven power and materials demand is filling Taiwanese order books years out. Hua Eng (華城) said it still cannot see a plateau in the heavy-electrical cycle, with orders already booked into 2029 and capacity full. Taiwan Glass (台玻) will invest another NT$2 billion this year to expand low-DK and low-CTE glass-fibre cloth lines, warning the cloth will stay in shortage into next year as high-end electronics demand booms. Together with KGI-flagged "big four" electromechanical names booked to 2029, the data point to a multi-year structural upcycle in AI-infrastructure hardware rather than a short-lived spike.

items.title_zh: 13 金控前五月狂賺 3,673 億元 創史上最強
items.title_en: All 13 financial holdings post record five-month profit of NT$367.3 billion
items.summary_zh: 在台股價量齊揚、匯市助攻下，13 家上市金控 5 月合計稅後純益 759 億元，寫史上最強 5 月；累計前五月稅後純益達 3,673 億元，年增高達 136% 創新高。超級股東會上，富邦金董座蔡明興、國泰金董座蔡宏圖、台新新光金董座吳東亮均看好 AI 應用推升出口，部分高層估全年 GDP 上看年增 10%。不過國泰金總座李長庚示警，隨台股創高、散戶槓桿升高，須關注「四貸同堂」過度借錢的隱憂。亮眼獲利雖反映資本市場榮景，但獲利高度倚賴股匯波動，後續若市場降溫，金控獲利動能能否延續值得觀察。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's 13 listed financial holding companies booked combined after-tax profit of NT$75.9 billion in May—their strongest May ever—taking cumulative five-month earnings to NT$367.3 billion, up a striking 136% year on year, powered by buoyant stock and currency markets. At their "super" shareholder meetings, the chairmen of Fubon, Cathay and Taishin-Shin Kong all argued AI applications would lift exports and could push GDP growth toward 10%. Cathay's president, however, flagged an emerging "four-loan household" over-borrowing problem as retail leverage rises alongside the record-high equity market.

items.title_zh: 中信銀出資 7,500 萬美元 力挺企業投資美國融保機制
items.title_en: CTBC Bank commits US$75 million to government's U.S.-investment guarantee scheme
items.summary_zh: 中信銀行以最高級距出資 7,500 萬美元，參與國發會「企業投資美國融資保證機制」，與 15 家公民營銀行共襄盛舉，首期籌資達 13.75 億美元，超越原訂 12 億美元目標。該機制將於 7 月上旬開跑，透過分擔跨境融資風險，協助台商深化全球供應鏈布局、特別是赴美擴廠投資。在行政院副院長鄭麗君、國發會主委葉俊顯見證下完成簽約，超額認購反映銀行業承作台商赴美資金潮的高度意願。對財管與企金客戶而言，此機制亦提供企業海外擴張更穩健的融資後盾，值得後續關注實際動撥情形與配套條件。
items.summary_en: CTBC Bank signed on at the top tier with a US$75 million contribution to the National Development Council's "Corporate Investment in the U.S. Financing Guarantee Mechanism," joining 15 public and private banks whose combined first-tranche funding reached US$1.375 billion—beating the original US$1.2 billion target. Launching in early July, the mechanism is designed to help Taiwanese firms deepen global supply-chain build-outs, particularly U.S. expansion, by de-risking cross-border financing. The strong over-subscription signals robust banking-sector appetite to underwrite the wave of Taiwanese capital heading to the United States.

items.title_zh: 金管會放寬證券輔助人受託交易範圍 並公布 4 月逾放
items.title_en: FSC widens securities scope for trading auxiliaries; April NPLs disclosed
items.summary_zh: 金管會放寬證券交易輔助人得受託交易之有價證券範圍，以滿足投資人多元交易需求；同時公布 115 年 4 月底本國銀行逾期放款情形，作為市場震盪下檢視銀行資產品質的例行但關鍵指標。兩項動作呼應監理一貫基調：在商品與通路面漸進鬆綁、提升市場便利性的同時，仍緊盯信用風險。在台股創高、家庭槓桿攀升之際，逾放數據與借款品質的變化，攸關金融體系韌性，後續走勢與相關裁罰、政策動向值得持續追蹤，以評估對銀行獲利與授信策略的影響。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission relaxed the range of securities that securities trading auxiliaries may be entrusted to trade, aiming to satisfy investors' demand for more diverse trading channels. Separately, the regulator released end-April figures on domestic banks' overdue loans, a routine but closely watched gauge of asset quality amid a volatile market. Both moves fit a broader supervisory theme of incrementally loosening product and channel rules while keeping a firm eye on credit risk, as record-high equity prices and rising household leverage raise questions about systemic resilience.

items.title_zh: 高資產客戶資金轉進現金 存款利率差距拉大
items.title_en: High-net-worth investors park cash as deposit rates diverge sharply
items.summary_zh: 台股劇烈洗三溫暖，高資產投資人紛紛獲利了結、降低風險，將資金轉為現金戰備部位等待進場訊號。遠東商銀 Bankee 社群銀行成為熱門停泊點，主打新台幣活存年利率 1.435%、高利無上限，據稱利息最高相差一般帳戶達 27 倍；市場同時出現澳幣定存年息上看 10% 的招攬。高資產族群在多空不明之際，明顯偏好兼具高息與流動性的停泊工具，優先考量靈活度與下檔保護，而非在過熱股市追價。對財管業者而言，現金與短天期商品的吸金力道升高，亦反映客戶資產配置正轉趨保守，後續資金何時回補風險性資產值得觀察。
items.summary_en: Amid the market's roller-coaster swings, affluent investors have been taking profits and shifting into cash war-chests, waiting for the next entry signal. Far Eastern Bankee's social-banking platform has become a popular parking spot, advertising a NT$1.435% demand-deposit rate with no cap—reportedly up to 27 times the interest of ordinary accounts. Separately, Australian-dollar time deposits are being marketed with yields as high as 10%. The hunt for high-yield, liquid holding places underscores how wealth clients are prioritising flexibility and downside protection over chasing a frothy equity tape.

items.title_zh: 安養信託與守護長者資產 成超高齡財管主軸
items.title_en: Trust and care-banking services move to centre stage in a super-aged society
items.summary_zh: 台灣邁入超高齡社會、詐騙手法翻新，守護長者資產成為財管與信託業務的重點。臺灣銀行以結合臨櫃關懷與安養信託、阻詐守財的做法，奪下第二屆樂齡金安獎第一名。壽險業者亦透過「百歲人生」論壇探討如何把長壽風險轉化為紅利。種種動向顯示，傳承規劃、安養信託與防詐機制，正從邊陲附加服務轉為財富管理的核心訴求。對高資產與退休族客戶而言，資產保全、傳承安排與長照需求的整合方案需求升溫；財管業者若能提供結合信託、保險與關懷服務的整體規劃，將更能貼合超高齡社會的傳承與守護需求。
items.summary_en: As Taiwan enters a super-aged society and fraud tactics evolve, protecting older clients' assets has become a priority for wealth and trust businesses. Bank of Taiwan won first place at the second Senior Financial Security Awards for combining over-the-counter care with安養 (long-term-care) trust services to block scams and safeguard retirees. Industry voices, including life insurers' "century-life" forums on turning longevity risk into a dividend, point to a structural shift: succession planning, care trusts and anti-fraud safeguards are becoming core wealth-management propositions rather than peripheral add-ons.

items.title_zh: 數位銀行擴大美股標的 搶搭 SpaceX 上市熱
items.title_en: Digital banks expand U.S.-stock access to ride the SpaceX frenzy
items.summary_zh: 純網銀將來銀行搭上 SpaceX 掛牌熱潮，持續升級財富管理服務，擴大美股可投資標的範圍，除涵蓋熱門美股 ETF 及台灣企業 ADR 外，並提供換匯減碼優惠，讓國人更便利參與全球資本市場。此舉反映在市場高度關注之際，數位與財管平台正競相把零售與大眾富裕客群的資金導入海外資產，降低跨境投資的摩擦成本。對財管業者而言，這凸顯爭奪客戶境外配置金流的競爭日趨激烈：以更低換匯成本與更廣商品架構吸引客戶，已成為財管 2.0 時代的關鍵戰場，後續手續費與匯差競爭態勢值得觀察。
items.summary_en: Riding the wave of SpaceX-driven enthusiasm, pure-play digital lender NEXT Bank (將來銀行) has widened its menu of investable U.S. equities—now covering popular U.S. ETFs and Taiwanese-company ADRs—and is offering reduced FX spreads to make global-market participation easier. The move reflects how digital and wealth platforms are racing to channel retail and mass-affluent demand into overseas assets at a moment of intense market interest, lowering frictions on cross-border investing. For wealth managers, it highlights intensifying competition to capture clients' offshore allocation flows through cheaper FX and broader product shelves.

items.title_zh: 實質經常性薪資漲幅創六年新高 加薪跑贏通膨
items.title_en: Real regular wages post fastest growth in six years as pay outpaces inflation
items.summary_zh: 主計總處發布最新薪資統計，剔除物價因素後，今年 1 至 4 月實質經常性薪資平均為 4 萬 4,115 元，年增 1.4%，創六年同期新高，意味即便 4 月物價升溫，加薪幅度仍超越通膨。官方另統計，去年有 34.8% 公司調薪、創 25 年新高；AI 需求大爆發更帶動 4 月電子零組件加班工時寫下 47 年同月新高。數據顯示勞動市場趨緊、薪資動能延續，有助支撐內需消費。惟須留意，名目薪資成長集中於電子與 AI 相關產業，產業間落差擴大，整體實質購買力改善程度仍受物價走勢牽動。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics said that, after stripping out price effects, average real regular earnings for January–April ran at NT$44,115, up 1.4% year on year—the strongest first-four-month gain in six years—meaning pay growth outpaced inflation even as April prices firmed. Separately, official data showed 34.8% of companies raised salaries last year, a 25-year high, while AI-fuelled demand drove April overtime hours in the electronic-components sector to a 47-year high for the month. The figures point to a tightening labour market underpinning domestic consumption.

items.title_zh: 經諮會首度召開 企業界籲超前部署電力
items.title_en: First economic advisory council convenes as firms urge pre-emptive power planning
items.summary_zh: 經濟部首度舉辦「經濟及產業發展諮詢會」，AI 浪潮推升產業用電需求，電力供應成為企業界最關注議題。經濟部長龔明鑫表示，企業界普遍呼籲政府超前部署、提前規劃電力供給。此議題呼應外電對 AI 用電需求大增的觀察，以及智慧電網有望為全球電力業節省 1.8 兆美元投資的研究。對台灣而言，確保穩定且可擴充的電力供應，正快速成為 AI 時代產業競爭力的戰略前提。如何在能源轉型、減碳目標與用電需求暴增之間取得平衡，將是政府與企業共同面對的長期課題，亦牽動半導體等高耗能產業的投資布局。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Ministry of Economic Affairs held its inaugural "Economic and Industrial Development Advisory Council," where business leaders flagged electricity supply as their top concern amid an AI-driven surge in industrial power demand. Minister Kung Ming-hsin relayed calls for the government to plan power capacity well ahead of need. The debate dovetails with research showing AI's electricity appetite and the case for smart grids that could save the global power industry US$1.8 trillion in investment. Securing reliable, expandable power is fast becoming a strategic prerequisite for Taiwan's AI-era industrial competitiveness.

items.title_zh: 新青安 2.0 寬限期可採 3+1+1 補貼落日壓力浮現
items.title_en: New youth-housing loan "2.0" tweaks and the looming subsidy cliff
items.summary_zh: 政策焦點落在新青安房貸方案。財政部長表示，新青安 2.0 寬限期可採「3+1+1」，並將考慮提高婚育宅貸款額度。另一方面，市場示警補貼落日壓力：隨原方案寬限期屆滿、補貼取消，千萬房貸家庭每月還款恐驟增約 1.8 萬元。一鬆一緊的雙線情節，凸顯政府在支持首購族與控管家庭債務之間的兩難。對購屋族而言，貸款條件調整將直接牽動還款負擔與購屋決策；在房價居高、家庭槓桿升高之際，相關配套上路時程與額度細節，將是後續觀察重點，亦影響銀行房貸授信與風險控管策略。
items.summary_en: Policy attention is centring on the government's youth-housing loan scheme. The finance minister indicated the new 青安 2.0 grace period could adopt a "3+1+1" structure and that authorities would consider raising loan ceilings for marriage- and childbirth-linked homes. At the same time, reports warned of a subsidy cliff: as the original programme's grace periods expire and subsidies are removed, a household with a NT$10 million mortgage could see monthly repayments jump by around NT$18,000. The dual storyline highlights the delicate balance between supporting first-home buyers and managing rising household debt.

items.title_zh: 美股四大指數齊收高 SpaceX 與美伊樂觀情緒帶動
items.title_en: U.S. equities close higher as four major indices rally on SpaceX and Iran optimism
items.summary_zh: 美股周五收高，市場持續消化美伊和平協議可能達成的消息，加上 SpaceX 史上最大 IPO 掛牌，四大指數齊步走高。SpaceX（SPCX）終場較承銷價勁揚約 19%、收在 161.11 美元，市值衝上 2.1 兆美元，躍居全美市值第六大上市公司；道瓊指數上漲約 1%。地緣政治風險降溫、風險偏好回升推動漲勢，但市場焦點迅速轉向多國央行接連決議利率的「超級周」。投資人關注 Fed、ECB 等央行動向，將牽動後續資金流向與股債走勢，短線漲多後仍須留意央行政策訊號帶來的波動。
items.summary_en: Wall Street ended Friday higher as investors digested the prospect of a U.S.–Iran peace deal and the historic SpaceX listing, with all four major indices finishing up. SpaceX (SPCX) closed roughly 19% above its IPO price at $161.11, lifting its market cap to $2.1 trillion and making it America's sixth-most-valuable public company; the Dow rose about 1%. Easing geopolitical risk and a return of risk appetite drove the gains, though attention quickly turned to a central-bank "super week" featuring multiple key rate decisions.

items.title_zh: 油價重挫 布蘭特跌至三個月低點 美伊和平在望
items.title_en: Energy slumps as Brent hits three-month low on Iran peace hopes
items.summary_zh: 國際油價重挫，市場傳出美伊最快周日簽署和平協議，押注荷姆茲海峽將重新開放，中東供應風險迅速降溫。布蘭特原油跌逾 3% 並跌至 3 月以來新低，OPEC 同步下修需求預測，進一步加劇賣壓；高盛亦下調 2027 年油價預期，理由是供應端增長強勁、需求轉弱。能源價格急轉直下，正透過降低通膨預期與壓低美元匯率傳導至金融市場。美元周線收黑、避險需求降溫，反映地緣風險溢價快速消退。惟協議若生變、海峽重啟時程延後，油價仍有反彈風險，後續簽署進度為關鍵觀察點。
items.summary_en: Crude oil tumbled as reports suggested the U.S. and Iran could sign a peace deal as soon as Sunday, with the market betting the Strait of Hormuz would reopen and Middle East supply risk faded fast. Brent crude fell more than 3% to its lowest since March, and OPEC simultaneously trimmed its demand forecast, adding to the selling pressure. Goldman Sachs also cut its 2027 oil-price outlook, citing strong supply growth and softening demand. The sharp reversal in energy prices is feeding through to lower inflation expectations and a weaker U.S. dollar.

items.title_zh: 歐洲車廠聯手喊「歐洲製造」 力抗中國競爭
items.title_en: European carmakers unite behind "Made in Europe" rules to counter China
items.summary_zh: 面對中國廉價電動車強勢入侵與日益嚴峻的經營環境，歐洲三大車廠福斯、Stellantis 與雷諾首度採取聯合行動，敦促歐盟制定明確的「歐洲製造」規則，以捍衛區域產業基礎。此次罕見的協同呼籲，凸顯中國競爭與成本通膨對歐洲汽車業的壓力升高。另一方面，亞股展現韌性：南韓綜合股價指數（Kospi）周五在三星、SK 海力士等半導體巨頭帶動下強勁回升，走出震盪的一周。整體而言，全球製造業正面臨中國價格競爭與供應鏈重組的雙重壓力，各國政策走向與產業聯盟動態，將牽動相關供應鏈與股市表現。
items.summary_en: Facing an onslaught of cheap Chinese electric vehicles and an increasingly harsh operating environment, Europe's three largest automakers—Volkswagen, Stellantis and Renault—took their first joint action, urging EU policymakers to craft clear "Made in Europe" rules to defend the bloc's industrial base. The coordinated appeal underscores mounting pressure on Europe's auto sector from Chinese competition and cost inflation. Meanwhile, Asian markets showed resilience: South Korea's Kospi rebounded strongly on Friday, led by chip giants Samsung and SK Hynix after a turbulent week.

items.title_zh: SpaceX 市值衝 2.1 兆美元 完成「金髮姑娘」式完美掛牌（2026-06-13）
items.title_en: SpaceX, Now Worth $2.1 Trillion, Pulls Off Goldilocks Debut (2026-06-13)
items.summary_zh: 隨投資人買單其登月級 AI 願景，SpaceX 完成一場異常順利的 IPO，馬斯克成為全球首位兆元富豪。這家火箭公司首日收漲約 19%、市值衝上 2.1 兆美元，躍居全美市值第六大上市公司。
items.summary_en: Elon Musk became the world's first trillionaire as SpaceX completed a remarkably smooth IPO, with investors buying into its moonshot AI vision. The rocket maker closed up about 19% with a $2.1 trillion market cap, ranking sixth among U.S. public companies.

items.title_zh: SpaceX 登陸那斯達克 馬斯克成全球首位兆元富豪（2026-06-13）
items.title_en: Elon Musk becomes world's first trillionaire as SpaceX begins trading on the Nasdaq (2026-06-13)
items.summary_zh: 馬斯克持有的 SpaceX 股權價值逾 7,660 億美元，加計特斯拉持股，截至周五其身家約達 1.05 兆美元。SpaceX 以史上最大 IPO 之姿正式在那斯達克掛牌交易。
items.summary_en: Musk's stake in SpaceX is worth more than $766 billion; combined with his Tesla holdings, his net worth reached roughly $1.05 trillion as of Friday, as the company began trading on the Nasdaq following its record-setting IPO.

items.title_zh: 美方：美伊協議可能數日內簽署 但非「百分百」確定（2026-06-13）
items.title_en: Trump administration: Iran deal signing likely in coming days, but not '100%' certain (2026-06-13)
items.summary_zh: 川普政府高級官員表示，結束伊朗戰爭的協議可能很快簽署，但在交戰雙方說法分歧下並非完全確定。川普另否認伊朗對協議條款的說法，並譴責一起新的無人機攻擊。
items.summary_en: A senior Trump administration official said a deal to end the Iran war could be signed soon, following conflicting statements from the warring nations. Trump separately disputed Iran's account of the terms and decried a new drone attack.

items.title_zh: 美國 5 月躉售物價上漲 1.1% 高於預期 能源價格飆升（2026-06-12）
items.title_en: Wholesale prices rose 1.1% in May, more than expected, on surge in energy (2026-06-12)
items.summary_zh: 美國 5 月生產者物價指數（PPI）月增 1.1%，遠高於市場預期的 0.7%，主因能源成本飆漲。這份偏熱的數據在多國央行關鍵決議前，加深市場對通膨的疑慮。
items.summary_en: The U.S. producer price index jumped 1.1% in May, well above the 0.7% Dow Jones consensus, driven by a surge in energy costs. The hot reading adds to inflation worries ahead of key central-bank decisions.

items.title_zh: 歐洲央行 2023 年來首度升息 伊朗戰爭推升能源成本（2026-06-11）
items.title_en: ECB hikes interest rates for first time since 2023 as Iran war ramps up energy costs (2026-06-11)
items.summary_zh: 歐洲央行自 2023 年以來首度升息，同時上調通膨預測、下修成長展望。伊朗衝突推升能源成本，威脅歐元區通膨預期失控，迫使央行打響「預期保衛戰」。
items.summary_en: The European Central Bank raised rates for the first time since 2023, lifting its inflation forecasts and cutting its growth outlook, as the Iran conflict pushed energy costs higher and threatened to unanchor inflation expectations in the euro zone.

items.title_zh: 英國 4 月經濟萎縮 0.1% 伊朗衝突拖累成長（2026-06-12）
items.title_en: UK economy shrank 0.1% in April as Iran conflict weighed on growth (2026-06-12)
items.summary_zh: 英國 4 月 GDP 下滑 0.1%，服務業活動走弱，企業並提及中東衝突帶來的壓力。數據凸顯伊朗戰爭的經濟外溢效應，正拖累主要已開發經濟體的成長動能。
items.summary_en: U.K. GDP fell 0.1% in April as services activity declined and companies cited pressure from the Middle East conflict, highlighting how the Iran war's economic spillover is dragging on major developed economies.

items.title_zh: 貝萊德私募信貸基金面臨 13% 贖回請求（2026-06-12）
items.title_en: BlackRock Private-Credit Fund Faces 13% Redemption Requests (2026-06-12)
items.summary_zh: 貝萊德一檔私募信貸基金的股東贖回請求升至 13%，高於上季，但提領將再度受限於 5% 上限。贖回升高凸顯快速擴張的私募信貸市場正累積流動性壓力，值得投資人留意。
items.summary_en: Shareholders in a BlackRock private-credit fund asked to redeem more than last quarter, with requests reaching 13%, though withdrawals will again be capped at 5%. The rising redemptions spotlight liquidity strains building in the booming private-credit market.

items.title_zh: 美司法部放行派拉蒙併購華納兄弟探索（2026-06-13）
items.title_en: Justice Department Clears Paramount-Warner Bros. Discovery Deal (2026-06-13)
items.summary_zh: 美國司法部放行派拉蒙以 810 億美元收購華納兄弟探索（Warner Bros. Discovery），為重塑媒體版圖邁出重要一步。該交易仍須取得歐洲監管機構核准才能完成。
items.summary_en: The U.S. Justice Department cleared Paramount's $81 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, a major step toward reshaping the media landscape. The deal still requires approval from European regulators before it can close.

items.title_zh: 「並非曇花一現」：價值股大幅領先成長股的原因（2026-06-13）
items.title_en: 'This is not a flash in the pan': Why value stocks are beating growth by such a wide margin (2026-06-13)
items.summary_zh: 今年價值股漲幅亮眼、大幅超越成長股，反映投資人樂觀看待獲利成長將從科技股向外擴散。分析師認為，此輪資金輪動是結構性轉變，而非短暫現象，後續走向值得關注。
items.summary_en: Value stocks are posting big gains this year that widely surpass growth equities, as investors grow optimistic that earnings growth is broadening beyond technology. Analysts argue the rotation reflects a durable shift rather than a short-lived move.
